title: Fragment::from_bytes may underflow if validation order changes
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:184

Issue: The subtraction `let payload_len = content_len - content_offset;` relies on validation at line 186-189 to ensure `content_len >= content_offset`. The safety invariant is implicit and not documented.

Edge case: For ALL_1 fragments (fcn == ALL_1_FCN), content_offset = MIC_LENGTH (4). The check at line 186 ensures content_len is at least MIC_LENGTH + 1 (5), preventing underflow. However:

1. The dependency between line 184 and line 186 is not obvious
2. Future refactoring could reorder these lines
3. No comment explains why this is safe

Impact: Currently safe, but fragile. A refactoring mistake could cause underflow and panic in release mode or wrap-around.

Suggested fix: Either:
1. Add a comment above line 184 explaining the safety invariant
2. Reorder to do the content_len validation BEFORE the subtraction
3. Use saturating_sub with an explicit check afterward
